prompts.prose: Write a long, detailed essay on how the invention of the printing press changed European science, religion and politics over the following three centuries.
prompts.code: Write a complete, well-commented Python module implementing a thread-safe LRU cache with TTL expiry, a decorator interface, statistics counters and an extensive unittest suite.
prompts.structured: Produce a detailed Markdown reference guide to TCP congestion control with headings, numbered steps, bullet lists and a comparison table of Reno, CUBIC, BBR and Vegas.
prompts.json: Output a JSON array of 40 fictional library books, each an object with title, author, year, isbn, genres (array), page_count, rating and a two-sentence summary. Output only JSON.
